description: Defines data structures, classes, and macros related to trigger shape decoding and angle calculations for engine control. Includes classes like TriggerShape, event_trigger_position_s, and trigger_shape_helper, with methods for initializing, adding events, and calculating trigger positions.

classes.name: event_trigger_position_s
classes.description: Represents a trigger event position with index, angle, and offset.

classes.name: trigger_shape_helper
classes.description: Helper class containing channel waveforms and pin states for trigger decoding.

classes.name: TriggerShape
classes.description: Main class representing trigger shape configuration and decoding logic, including event management and synchronization.

methods.name: initializeTriggerShape
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape with logger, operation mode, and configuration.

methods.name: findTriggerPosition
methods.description: Calculates trigger position based on current angles and shape.

methods.name: calculateExpectedEventCounts
methods.description: Calculates expected event counts based on trigger configuration.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds a trigger event at a specific angle and channel.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns total number of shaft events per revolution.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the trigger definition.

methods.name: prepareShape
methods.description: Prepares internal data structures for trigger shape processing.
